entities.summary: Lindsay Wilson Dozier Allen is an American professional basketball player for the Connecticut Sun of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) and for Çukurova Basketbol of the Turkish Super League. She played college basketball for the Notre Dame Fighting Irish. She was drafted in the second round of the 2017 WNBA draft by the New York Liberty.
